args.title: Triage issue 4409
args.body:
File: README.md

The issue points out that following the local setup steps with a MinIO container fails because S3_ENDPOINT is not mentioned in the README.md local setup steps, causing uploads to go to AWS S3 instead. The maintainer confirmed S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 is needed, and the reporter mentioned creating the bucket. README.md needs updating.
